name: devops-agent-usage-cost-reporter
description: Answers 'what does running AWS DevOps Agent cost me in API usage?' by measuring the downstream, second-order cost on the regular AWS bill: reads the agent's own call log, isolates the few billed operations (CloudWatch Logs Insights StartQuery dominates), prices them live from the AWS Price List API (HALT on empty, list price = upper bound), and reconciles against Cost Explorer or the CUR. Distinct from the usage-credit monitor (101), which covers direct agent-second usage versus support credits. Read-only, estimate-only. Recommends AWS Pricing and Billing/Cost MCP augmentation used alongside the direct reads.

trigger.description: Runs monthly on the 1st at 09:00 UTC
